relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: The results indicated that the expression of IL-1β, TNF-α, IL-6 in spinal cord were significantly up-regulated in paclitaxel treated mice compared with saline group

relationships.subject: echinacoside
relationships.evidence_quote: Echinacoside (200mg/kg) prophylactic administration significantly prevented the paclitaxel-induced upregulation of inflammatory cytokines.

relationships.subject: echinacoside
relationships.evidence_quote: Echinacoside (200mg/kg) administration significantly attenuated microglial activation

relationships.subject: echinacoside
relationships.evidence_quote: Repeated injections of echinacoside 200mg/kg, but not 100mg/kg significantly alleviated this reduction

key_findings: Prophylactic echinacoside dose-dependently prevented paclitaxel-induced mechanical, thermal and cold hypersensitivity in mice.
It reduced spinal microglia/astrocyte activation, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6 and hind paw nerve fiber loss.
